defect: binary FIFO pointer crosses domains without coherent encoding
rationale: Binary increments can toggle several pointer bits; synchronized bits can falsely indicate available data.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A multi-bit binary counter is synchronised bit-wise; several bits change at once, so incoherent values can be captured.
